options.opc: The presence or absence of a wrap around the capsid.

enhanced_information: The hepatitis A virus and the hepatitis C virus are differentiated by their type of genetic material, with hepatitis A having a single-stranded RNA genome and hepatitis C also having a single-stranded RNA genome.
